title: Formulae
content:
Least count of the travelling microscope:
LC = M / N
where M = value of 1 main scale division, N = total number of divisions on the vernier scale.

Total reading on either side:
TR = MSR + (VSR × LC)

Ring diameter:
D = |R1 − R2|
where R1 and R2 are the total readings on the left-hand and right-hand sides of the ring.

Working (algebraic) formula for wavelength:
λ1 = [D²(n+m) − D²(n)] / (4 · m · R)
where m is the fixed ring-number interval between two paired rows (commonly 4), and R is the radius of curvature of the lens.

Graphical formula for wavelength:
λ2 = (slope of the D² vs. ring-number graph) / (4R)

Final result (average of both methods):
λ = (λ1 + λ2) / 2

Percentage error:
% error = |Standard value − Experimental value| / Standard value × 100
Standard value of sodium light = 5893 Angstrom (the mean of the sodium doublet lines at 5890 Å and 5896 Å).
